Package org.apache.juneau.console.views

Interface RowDetailMixin

All Known Implementing Classes:
OrdersRest, PetsRest, UsersRest
public interface RowDetailMixin
Mixin that serves the bean-backed row details of a resource.

An implementing resource lists its bean-backed details in rowDetails(). Each detail is served under its key at three endpoints: the detail (row-detail/{key}/{id}), one tab (row-detail/{key}/{id}/tab/{tabId}) and the tab counts (row-detail/{key}/{id}/counts).

Only readable, non-ignored bean properties that the owning table shows (or the detail names explicitly) are ever served. Every failure — an unknown key, tab or row, a null lookup result or a malformed id — answers the same empty 404 with Cache-Control: no-store, so nothing about what exists can be learned from the response.

Since:
10.0.0
